_comment: Victory quotes shown on the win screen. Up to 4 entries per character; the engine cycles through them. Sources: KOF '98 in-game quotes (SNK Wiki / KOF Fandom / Wikiquote), Street Fighter Alpha 2 quotes for the SF guests (GameFAQs Quotes/Dialogue Guide #916 and Street Fighter Wiki), M. Bison from the Street Fighter II series (Street Fighter Wiki), Fatal Fury / Art of Fighting quotes for the SNK guests. See README.md in this folder.
iori: No value in a broken toy. That's all you losers are.
A rose blooms best near death. You're in full bloom, pal!
Geez, sorry. There's no cure for stupidity!
This is your last fight. A memorable final act!
kyo: You just ain't got it. Stop whining and get lost.
That's it? I'm not angry, just disappointed.
Burn in the fury of my flames, you weakling.
Eat my flames of fury. Grovel before Kusanagi.
shingo: Did you see me, mom?! I won! King of the world!
I am Shingo Yabuki! I'll be honored to challenge you!
Kusanagi-san's enemy is my enemy! You can't pass!
Father! Could you check my Kusanagi style?
rugal: Repeat after me: I'll never take on a god again.
saisyu: Defeat is defeat. Fighting's no picnic, kid.
You think you can win against me?
heidern: You let your guard down? I think you're a weenie!
takuma: Wow, you're a disgrace! Better hang it up, kid.
clark: Losers have no rights. That's what history's about.
I had fun. For about five seconds.
You've nothing to regret. You came this far.
ralf: That's enough. I can only be forgiving so much.
Take it easy on chicks? No way!
You fought like a star. A dead one.
leona: Had enough? Then beat it, fool!
Why did you do it? You had no chance.
mature: Good night. Forever. Have a million sweet dreams.
vice: I'm through. There are no more bones to break.
Just looking at you makes me mad!
benimaru: My reason for winning? I'm just cool. Real cool!
Lambs are tougher than you. How do I know?
Someone as good-looking as me has to win.
If you can't win elegantly, don't win at all!
daimon: A peaceful world is the best one!
terry: Say what? It's no fluke. This is why I'm here every year.
You had guts, kid. Now clean them off the pavement!
If you don't have fangs, don't flap your gums!
It's going to be our century!
andy: If you want to be the best, practice every day, pal.
You can't win only by power.
You move like an elephant in a tutu! Hit the showers!
Faith is what wins. And a devastating left hook!
joe: How's that? I'm the Satan of martial arts.
All of you are just big!
You never had a chance against the kickboxing king!
Maybe we were just too strong!
ryo: Absolute karate. That's Kyokugen. Don't forget it!
robert: Underestimate me, huh? You're dumber than you look!
You're one of the strongest. Not!
yuri: I'm Kyokugen! Face it, Ryo. You can't beat me!
athena: Sorry about that. Are you hurt? I got carried away.
You rely on power too much!
There's no tea time for heroines! Let's go!
I put my heart into that match. Thank you!
kensou: New threads. New attitude. The new Kensou is here!
Don't worry! We are too strong!
Good fight! Let us do it again!
I'm no psychic, but I am a psycho!
chin: I get power from wine. Next time you can test it.
I am not drunk, I am sober.
Little guys, practice more and get stronger.
You were beaten by an old man!
king: In battle, sex means nothing. Who's left standing matters.
mai: With this body and strength, you thought you had a chance?
No one calls me babe without paying for it.
You OK? Sorry. I wasn't even trying.
I'm hot this year. It might be my millennium.
chizuru: Play time's over. Winning's too easy. You can't touch me!
You can't win, let alone touch me.
If your heart breaks, you can't win at anything.
It's over. You never had a chance.
kim: How about it? Let's do the Tae Kwon Do thing!
Don't make light of Tae Kwon Do!
Strength without justice is violence. Got that?
chang: Scooby dooby doo wop. Doo wop, ah doo doo.
That's all? Kim's kid is tougher than you!
A crushing victory! Heh, heh, heh.
choi: You did pretty good just to last this long.
Winning isn't everything. It's the only thing, loser!
A quick win. This time, I'm really free!
yashiro: You're not too bad. That is, you're second.
Size, speed, and strength. With these, I won't lose.
Why did I win? Ask yourself, loser.
shermie: Game over, pal! Don't forget to save. Sweet dreams!
Done already? That was only the aperitif.
I won't like it if it hurts.
chris: You make me laugh, chump. And laugh, and laugh!
yamazaki: Annoying! Annoying! You're just so annoying!
mary: This isn't about logic. It's about smashing your face in!
Oh, you're OK. I did take it easy on you!
A first rate warrior wins without lifting a finger.
Everyone knows their limits. You got more than others.
billy: How does it feel to be well done? Bet you taste terrible.
You're not ready for the big leagues, kid.
I'll burn you to a crisp!
lucky: Wake up! It's too early for bedtime.
I knew I went a little overboard!
heavyd: Slow. Your attack's too slow. I read you like a book.
brian: Your defense means nothing to my tackling!
geese: Hmph. That street act could never beat me!
krauser: Oppose me with such low ability. You make me laugh.
I'll chisel your gravestone. Sleep well!
mrbig: How's that? Now you know what I'm big at, don't you?
eiji: Kisaragi-ryu is invincible. My ninja arts are matchless.
Tell future generations of my brilliance!
Hate the heavens for being born in my era.
How foolish. The battle was mine from the start.
vega: Get lost! You can't compare with my powers!
Anyone who opposes me will be destroyed!
You're no match for my Psycho Power!
I will weep when there are no more worlds to conquer.
ryu: I look forward to our next battle.
You fought well. I was honored.
Now I'll find a better challenge!
What's wrong? Why do you hold back?
ken: Don't tell me you're actually unconscious.
Next time I won't be so easy on you!
Now you see the difference between us!
You're better than you look. Try harder.
chunli: I don't have time for amateurs!
If you're going to fight, fight for real.
You don't have the skill to beat me!
sakura: Do you have time for another beating before class?
Now you know, justice always prevails!
Victory is mine. Get up so I can smack you again!
Wow, that was cool. Do it again!
kyonests: You just ain't got it. Stop whining and get lost.
That's it? I'm not angry, just disappointed.
Burn in the fury of my flames, you weakling.
Eat my flames of fury. Grovel before Kusanagi.
